hero.title: Style it myself
hero.description: Your photo and preferences stay on the left, any jacket from the catalog can be selected in the center, and the AI multi-dimensional score, styling advice, and MBTI analysis appear on the right.
hero.usage: Choose a down jacket in the center, then select Analyze this look on the right. Changing the color, MBTI, size, or photo invalidates the analysis and requires a new run.

catalog.title: Down Jacket Catalog
catalog.description: Search and select a down jacket from the catalog for custom styling.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search brand, style, color, or feature, for example white outdoor waterproof
catalog.genderFallback: No more gender-preferred products matched; all adult styles are shown for manual selection.
catalog.empty: No down jackets are available for these conditions.

analysis.title: AI Styling Analysis
analysis.description: Analyze how the selected item matches your personal conditions.
analysis.empty: Choose a jacket in the center to start your custom styling analysis.
analysis.noResult: Your photo and profile are ready. Start the analysis above to see multi-dimensional scores, styling advice, and MBTI-based style analysis.

profile.title: Body Profile
profile.description: Your photo and preferences are inherited from the main page. Adjust them here and the analysis will use the latest profile.
